title: Research: three reciprocal guard bits from directed rounding (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Section09's reciprocal proof treats all rounding errors symmetrically and uses five fractional guard bits. Preserving the actual floor-rounding signs gives a written uniform theorem with **three guards**, retaining seed5/8, the six-bit warm-up, exact products and capped doubling. For every real1<=c<2 and integerp>=1, the returned x satisfies |1-cx|<2^-(p+1) and |x-1/c|<2^-(p+1).

Three is sharp for propagating the existing residual invariant from arbitrary admitted dyadic states: exact witnesses reject zero, one and two guards. Those states are not the actual warm-up outputs, so optimality of the seeded two-guard routine remains open.

Only research/reciprocal-directed-guards/ is added: proof, two separately written arithmetic ports, exact receipts, eight semantic/package test groups, source pins and opt-in replay. **Explicit side result; no kappa gain.** Section09 is a downstream corollary, not a multiplication dependency. Root outer precision, physical tape/head costs, selected suppliers, compiler/analytic transfer, complete root/recovery substitution and proof-kernel checking remain outside scope.

## Task and overlap

Task uniform-transfer-audit, priority3; scope refined to its precision branch, explicitly labelled as a side result. Nonce b43a43f25c1b77e3be01ef6fdcf22b71, scope key603f341b99f590f17a76. Claim: [Discussion1634](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1634). Base0a201997097b8a89b638f3a2afcb35db4184c8b2; publication parent858771bcca3b8dd5d4ef4aa682a13cc9b7e23920 has unchanged guidance, catalog, selected record and Section09 blobs. TASK.json and SOURCES.json pin provenance and the consumed source.

Nearest predecessor: [Hanson Sun's PR1528](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1528), head f43caa53c5cc9717a8a04fe5a1538e31adeef313, checks the retained Newton routines atp1..8 and leaves the uniform argument open. This adds a directed-rounding guard refinement and quantified induction; no pending executable is imported. PR1379 already closes the tempting parking target and was not duplicated.

Final overlap:661 open PR bodies with complete pagination and349 local metadata records, fresh board/handoff reads and a Newton Discussion search. Discussion pagination is incomplete; text coverage is not a novelty guarantee. No matching guard refinement was found in the inspected scope.

## Validation

Reproduce: python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/reciprocal-directed-guards

Registered CPython3.12.14/macOSarm64 replay passes in13.989s. Both implementations agree on complete traces for16,320 common prefix cells atp1..8; the separate integer checker covers81,920 cells throughp10,387,392 stage cells and774,784 endpoint checks. It preserves all incoming warm-up bits at the smaller first-stage precision. Exact symbolic residual/slack identities corroborate the written proof; finite cells do not prove arbitrary precision by enumeration.

All eight test groups pass:4,995 general-invariant states,120 nondyadic interior executions, wrong sign, lower guards, omitted warm-up, stale prefix, invalid domains, actual source/receipt corruption, occupied output and read-only optimized relocation. Metadata/pins,20 repository research-workflow tests, selected baseline source bindings and staged whitespace checks pass. VALIDATION.json records commands/environment/omissions. No selected cold replay, hosted CI, kernel theorem, literal tape implementation or end-to-end timing is claimed.

## Credit

Credit Hanson Sun (@bbMisk)/PR1528, OpenAI's retained manuscript and its classical Brent reductions, and Douglas Colkitt's repository/audit guidance. Source notices remain unchanged. Prepared for @ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, independent implementations, mathematical review, verification and writing. Two bounded subagents; no independent human or kernel review claimed. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

Package README/TASK.json state the two bounded follow-ups: derive a stronger reachable-state invariant to decide seeded two-guard correctness; formalize the floor-grid induction, then bind/replay the complete nested-root and exact-recovery caller. Additional finite no-failure cells cannot settle the first question.
